periods.time: Final phase of the second Tokyo defensive battle

name.zh: 宁音一辉珠雫史黛菈返国与美军撤退
name.en: Nene, Ikki, Shizuku and Stella Return; the US Retreats

periods.summary: The reinforcements from Vermillion return at the exact moment Kurono's ten minutes matter. Nene rides a meteor into Enterprise, crippling it and catching the exhausted Kurono. Shizuku freezes Tokyo Bay while she and miniature Ikki combine body and powers to reproduce Ryoma Kurogane's ice swordsmanship, destroying warships and EDY. After Upton refuses to retreat and fires one last Justicefier shot at Tokyo, Stella intercepts the beam with Calusaritio Salamander and cuts Enterprise in half. The US fleet withdraws, and Itsuki announces Japan's victory.
periods.cause: Kurono's awakening delays PSYON and Enterprise long enough for the Vermillion return party and Kyushu forces to reach Tokyo.
periods.process: Nene's Hadou Tensei meteor smashes Enterprise and shifts the air battle. Shizuku's Frost Plains traps the fleet; merged Ikki and Shizuku use Kujira and Toudan to break ships, then separate so Shizuku can destroy EDY internally while Ikki boards a carrier. Upton, wounded and obsessed with justice, rebuilds one cannon and fires again. Stella arrives in the beam path, rejects his justification for civilian sacrifice, and overwhelms the hadron beam with her dragon fire sword.
periods.outcome: Enterprise is destroyed, Upton's communications vanish, and the US fleet retreats toward Guam. Japan wins the defensive war, though the deeper crisis remains unresolved.
periods.significance: The volume's largest battlefield victory; Japan survives the US invasion and the main cast returns from Vermillion just in time for the final arc setup.
